# Notes service

Node 20 and PostgreSQL 16. Run the tests with `npm test`.
Deploys from main through GitHub Actions.

content.text:
I read README.md first: the notes service runs Node 20 and PostgreSQL 16, tests run with `npm test`, and it deploys from main through GitHub Actions. I will build on PostgreSQL.

I recommend the full body, because people search for what they wrote, not for what they titled it.

Should search cover the full note body, or only titles?

A) Full body (Recommended) - indexes every note body; costs more storage and a reindex on each edit.
B) Titles only - cheap and fast; misses most real queries.
C) Titles plus first paragraph - a middle ground; misses anything past the first paragraph.
